chunk_findings.detail: The fix marks every preserved round as free, but never bounds how many times a preserved pass may be reused. chunk_findings.detail: The new `_delta_cut` path is guarded by `not a["base"]`. chunk_findings.detail: The guard at the diff-selection branch only bypasses `_delta_cut` when an explicit `--base`/`--commit` is supplied, but this `kind == "chunk"` block still unconditionally copies `delta_from`, `delta_raised`, `delta_findings`, and `full_coverage` from the prior delta record. In the explicit-base retry case the triage added (`base` after the reviewed head, MID), the selected diff is not "the delta since `delta_from`", yet the new record is stamped with that old delta start and old `delta_raised`. A later `--chunk` retry of this new record will cut from the stale `delta_from` instead of the explicit base, so the same moved-diff failure can recur.
